build_nomic_bert_model: build a NomicBertModel from a NomicBertConfig with embeddings, rotary embeddings, and transformer layers
run_masked_lm: run a NomicBertForMaskedLM forward pass on input tokens and compute masked language modeling loss
classify_sequence: classify a sequence with NomicBertForSequenceClassification using pooled output and a linear classifier head
perform_token_classification: perform token classification with NomicBertForTokenClassification on per-token hidden states
apply_rotary_position_embedding: apply rotary position embedding to query and key tensors using cos and sin position encodings
